##### Project general facts

Al Ghadeer Parks by Aldar is a residential community of townhouses and villas designed around connection, open parks and shared spaces for every generation. Clean geometric volumes, light-toned facades, warm natural panels and large windows give the architecture a calm, contemporary character. The community is delivered in two phases, and each home rises from a ground floor to a first floor, offering two- and three-bedroom townhouses and four-bedroom villas, with selected villas featuring private pools.

Amenities bring neighbours together every day. A community centre forms the heart of neighbourhood life, while a swimming pool, a splash pad and a general play area give children space to play freely. A multi-sports area supports an active lifestyle, and an events lawn hosts community movie nights and weekend celebrations. Desert stargazing lawns, shaded walkways with planted canopies and streets that prioritise pedestrians complete a relaxed, family-friendly setting, with a British school close by.

Open-plan interiors are generous in proportion and thoughtfully designed around family life, extending into private gardens and shaded terraces. Homes are offered in light and dark colour schemes, with porcelain tile floors and staircases, wood-effect laminate joinery, solid colour kitchen cabinets and brushed nickel or bronze detailing. Bedrooms provide calm, private retreats, and generous windows bring in natural light throughout. Homes are delivered unfurnished, leaving furniture and decoration to the owner's own taste.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Ghadeer is a nature-inspired community within the Seih Al Sedeirah masterplan, located precisely between Abu Dhabi and Dubai. Manicured parks, feature lakes and tree-lined pathways shape the neighbourhood, while Al Ghadeer British School, part of Aldar Education, and established community facilities serve families who prefer a calmer pace of life close to both cities, with retail, cafes and green spaces close to home.

Al Maktoum International Airport is a short drive away, while Zayed International Airport, Yas Island, the centre of Abu Dhabi and Dubai International Airport are within comfortable driving distance. Sheikh Zayed Road, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Fayah Road connect the community with both emirates, and Expo City Dubai and Dubai South sit close by for work, shopping and leisure.

Seih Al Sedeirah sits on the corridor where Dubai and Abu Dhabi are growing towards each other, anchored by the expansion of Al Maktoum International Airport. Successive phases of Al Ghadeer selling out ahead of each release demonstrate strong demand. Freehold ownership, accessible entry points for family homes and continued investment by the master developer support long-term value for owners and investors.
